name: buffalo-2aa98683-blind28-ots
instr:
# Buffalo web framework misbehaving from startup to response, without a test suite

An application built with this framework now answers wrongly in a long series of unrelated everyday situations, from the moment the process starts up to the bytes that reach the browser. Nothing about the protocol changed and nothing about the calling code changed. The repository has received 28 separate undocumented edits.

Bringing an application up and having a request reach the code meant to handle it. Start one with every option left unset and send an ordinary fetch to the port it was configured for, and nothing answers: the connection is refused before any shutdown was asked for, so a request made while the process is supposedly running never completes. Post a form carrying a _method value of PUT to a path that has only a PUT handler wired up, and the request is no longer translated into that handler, so its body never comes back. Mount a directory of static content under a public prefix and ask for an image beneath it, and the bytes are not returned, nor does the answer carry the caching age header it should, whether the age setting is left as shipped or set to 3600.

The convenience functions produced for the paths an application declares are a mess. The labels derived from paths come out different from what pages expect: the bare /, /users/{user_id}/children, /admin/planes/{plane_id}/edit and a path that consumes two distinct parameters of its own each yield a label other than the one
